title: Bonsai Grove
description: Sculpt a living 3D bonsai — pick a species, tap branches to prune, tune the wind, and save it to your grove.
concept: A WebGL procedural tree generator with real hand-rolled 3D geometry: five species (Juniper, Willow, Sakura, Maple, Birch) each grow with distinct branching physics, and four seasonal palettes recolor leaves and ground from spring blossoms to bare winter. Orbit the camera, tap any branch to snip it off (with all its children), and dial in wind strength to watch the whole tree sway on the GPU.
features: 5 procedural tree species with unique branching angles, decay curves, and gravity bias (droop vs. upright)
4 seasonal palettes — spring blossoms, summer green, autumn color, bare snow-dusted winter
Tap-to-prune any branch (removes its whole subtree) plus full orbit/zoom camera control
Save trees to a personal localStorage Grove with thumbnails, export the current view as PNG, copy a shareable seed link, and download your whole Grove as JSON
tech: Procedural recursive branch generation (Mulberry32 seeded RNG)
Billboard leaf shader with per-vertex wind sway
Pointer Events (drag orbit, pinch zoom, tap-to-prune raycast)

interaction.mouse: Drag to orbit the camera, scroll wheel to zoom, click a branch to prune it
interaction.click: Tap/click a branch (movement < 8px) prunes it and its children; species/season pills switch presets
interaction.touch: One-finger drag orbits, two-finger pinch zooms, tap prunes a branch
interaction.keyboard: Arrow keys orbit the camera, +/- zoom in and out
